arguments.message:
The SSO sign‑in button only shows up when two things are true:
1. Your workspace has configured SSO for your email domain, and
2. The identity‑provider sync has already created your account in Meridian.
If the button is missing, it usually means the sync hasn’t created your account yet. An admin can confirm this in **Settings → People** – SSO‑provisioned accounts are listed with the identity provider name. If you don’t see your account there, the sync is still pending or your domain isn’t set up for SSO. Ask your admin to check the SSO configuration and ensure the sync runs, after which the SSO button should appear.
